selection_method: Selected from complete raw encoder/camera curves and all eleven onset zooms before computing or reading model errors for this recording. Every visible free release retained. Held pose uses 0.5 s ending 0.05 s before observed onset; free interval begins 0.12 s after onset and ends before static tail. Exact hand-clear is not independently verified. The final hand raise has no observed release before STOP, so is explicitly retained as an unscored setup interval.

unscored_raw_intervals.reason: Hand raising/setup from hanging; no held-to-free-decay transition before collection ended. This is not an observed release, and no prediction error was used to exclude it.
